mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active and does not require specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates for equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime characterized by rising new housing starts, consumer confidence in the housing sector increases, boosting retail spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. This mechanism is always active and does not require specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 3.0%) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS below 4.0%) signals a favorable environment for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer spending slowdown regime, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals reduced consumer confidence and weaker demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
